items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 as fracture damage to an internal fitting from frost; indemnity includes like-for-like replacement, labour, and necessary materials. Reference Case 16 shows t between 48 and 55 for a similar fitting.
Directly related to the frost-burst fitting repair (2.4.4, 7.1.9); connection elements renewed with the fitting are indemnified. Reference Case 16: t between 27 and 33.
Labour for covered repair is indemnified (7.1.7(f), 7.1.9). Reference Case 16: t >= 274 for 3 hrs senior installer.
Consumables actually used in covered work are indemnified (7.1.7(e)), but reference Case 16 shows t below 11, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).
One attendance per undertaking is indemnified if covered work was done (7.1.11). Reference Case 16: t >= 60 for vehicle costs.
Leak location is covered if the cause is insured (2.4.6, 5.2.2), but reference Case 16 shows t below 57, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).

items.description: Facade frost damage from outdoor freeze-thaw
items.rationale: Frost action on external surfaces is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (2.6.4, 3.5). The schedule does not show this peril as agreed, so t = 0.
Removal of failed external render is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Renewal of base plaster on external surface is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.

items.description: Premium insulated render system (upgrade on former plain plaster)
items.rationale: Upgrade beyond pre-loss standard is not covered (7.1.10), and external frost damage is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Work on external surfaces damaged by frost is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Painting of external surfaces after frost damage is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Work on undamaged elevations is not covered (7.1.5, 3.5). Not indemnified.
Priming of external surfaces after frost damage is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Labour for work on external surfaces damaged by frost is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
Flat rate for painting work on external surfaces damaged by frost is not covered unless the optional peril is agreed (3.5). Not indemnified.
